field.name: selectedfiles
field.label: Selected Files
field.description: Selected files will be cleared by closing folder

field.name: selcat
field.label: Joomla Category
field.description: Default track categories are specified in global options. Here you can override the default or create a category based on import date for all item types created by the current import.

field.name: impcat
field.label: Select Tracks Category
field.description: This will only apply to tracks that are created by this import. Artists, Albums and Songs will use the global default

field.name: splitsongs
field.label: Split medley to songs
field.description: attempt to split track titles containing , or / into separate songs

field.name: nobrackets
field.label: Song Title remove brackets
field.description: Remove text in square or round brackets when cresating song titles. Often this is used to indicate a live performance or recording date, but sometimes may be a valid part of the title. eg 'Have You Ever Been (to Electric Ladyland)

field.name: logfile
field.label: Select log to view
field.description: Log files in /xbmusic-data/logs are named with import type and date last saved. New file is started each day.

field.name: csvfile
field.label: Select CSV file
field.description: File should be in the /xbmusic-data folder

field.name: azstation
field.label: Select Station
field.description: Station defines the path to the media folder within /xbmusic. Select 'No station' to use /xbmusic/ as the media root

field.name: updateazids
field.label: Update option
field.description: Either Update all existing az_tid if track filename present in list, or only update missing ones.

field.name: expmissfiles
field.label: Save Missing Files List
field.description: Save list of files not found in media folder

field.name: expmisstrks
field.label: Save Missing Tracks List
field.description: Save list of files that exist but are not yet in database. Will save full rows from the AzTid import file in CSV format

field.name: fmnote1
field.label: XBMUSIC_MUSIC_FILES
field.description: Music files are hardcoded to a folder xbmusic/ in the root of the joomla installation. To include files from a different location on the server you can create a symlink to the target folder below. You must ensure that the WebServer user has read and write access to the folder. For most common Apache2 installations the user is www-data. It may be simplest to make the target nusic folder read-write for all users (chmod -R 777 [targetfolderpath]), The server will need to be able to read the entire path to the target and have read+write permissions for the target folder and subfolders

field.name: link_target
field.label: New Symlink Target
field.description: Enter the absolute path to the target folder where music files are stored

field.name: link_name
field.label: Link name in /xbmusic/
field.description: Enter the name for the new symlink under /xbmusic. Must not be an existing folder or file in xbmusic/. Path can include subfolders which must not already exist. eg if mystation/media/ already exists as either symlink or real folder under /xbmusic/ then you cannot create a new symlink at mystation/oldmedia because mystation/ already exists.

field.name: fmnote2
field.description: Once you have created the symlink and imported tracks from it you must not delete it without first deleting all the tracks and related info
